prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a good starting point: it’s relatively affordable (reported plans start around **$29/month**) and tracks whether your business appears in answers across several AI platforms, not just ChatGPT.

If you mainly want to check **local recommendations**—for example, “best plumber in [city]” or “best café near me”—a more specialized local-business tracker may fit better. One option in the results is **MentionedOn**, which monitors local recommendation questions, though it costs more (reported at about **$82.50/month**).

Before subscribing, check that the service covers the AI engines and locations you care about, and that it lets you track your own realistic customer questions. AI answers can vary by wording, location, and time, so treat the results as a trend rather than a definitive ranking.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
